items.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance
items.summary: With GPT-6 Sol and Luna, OpenAI adds two cheaper models that deliver their predecessors' performance at half the token price and take aim at Anthropic's pricier offerings. Independent analyses find little gain in actual intelligence, though, and OpenAI likely didn't see Anthropic's simultaneous launch of Opus 5.5 coming. The article OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 透過 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna，OpenAI 推出了兩款更便宜的模型，以半價的 Token 價格提供其前代模型的效能，並將矛頭指向 Anthropic's 較昂貴的產品。不過，獨立分析發現實際智慧程度幾無提升，而且 OpenAI 可能沒料到 Anthropic's 會同時推出 Opus 5.5。這篇名為 OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance 的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1 performance at lower cost and promises less "Claudish" writing
items.summary: Anthropic is launching Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in a new generation. The company says it matches Claude Fable 5.1 on most tasks while costing about 40 percent less to run than Opus 5. Anthropic's benchmarks also put it ahead of OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on most tasks, despite being significantly cheaper. Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are expected in the coming weeks. The article Claude Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1 performance at lower cost and promises less "Claudish" writing appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出新一代的首款模型 Claude Opus 5.5。該公司表示，它在多數任務上與 Claude Fable 5.1 相當，而運行成本比 Opus 5 低約 40%。儘管價格顯著便宜，但 Anthropic's 基準測試也顯示它在多數任務上領先 OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra。Sonnet 5.5 和 Haiku 5.5 預計將在未來幾週內推出。這篇題為 Claude Opus 5.5 的文章發表在 The Decoder 上，內容為以更低的成本達到 Fable 5.1 的效能，並承諾減少「更像 Claude」的寫作風格。

items.title: OpenAI calls for international standards on AI that could improve itself
items.summary: OpenAI wants international standards for recursive self-improvement, where AI systems independently build the next generation of AI. Without safeguards, humans could lose control over this process. OpenAI says the US should take the lead on global measurement standards and oversight rules. The article OpenAI calls for international standards on AI that could improve itself appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 呼籲為遞迴自我改進（即 AI 系統獨立建立下一代 AI）制定國際標準。如果沒有安全防護措施，人類可能會失去對此過程的控制。OpenAI 表示，美國應該在全球衡量標準和監督規則方面居於領先地位。這篇名為 OpenAI 的文章首次發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: A tiny software layer from lab-grown neurons promises faster, cheaper AI video
items.summary: The Biological Computing Co. wants to team up with AWS to sell a text-to-video model that's supposed to run five times faster and 80 percent cheaper thanks to a software layer derived from real nerve cells. The tiny layer adds less than 0.1 percent to the base model, but the startup won't say which model that is. The article A tiny software layer from lab-grown neurons promises faster, cheaper AI video appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: The Biological Computing Co. 希望與 AWS 合作銷售一款文字轉影片模型，據稱由於採用了源自真實神經細胞的軟體層，其運行速度可快上五倍，成本更可降低 80%。這個微小的軟體層對基礎模型的影響不到 0.1%，但這家新創公司拒絕透露那是哪一個模型。這篇名為 A tiny software layer from lab-grown neurons promises faster, cheaper AI video 的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Xiaomi's affordable flagship AI leads the open models, and Anthropic says Claude helped get it there
items.summary: With MiMo-V2.6-Pro, Xiaomi moves to the top of the openly available AI models and drastically undercuts the competition on price. What makes that possible is massive reinforcement learning that cost $2.62 million. But the success comes with a catch: Anthropic accuses the company of siphoning off training data from Claude. The article Xiaomi's affordable flagship AI leads the open models, and Anthropic says Claude helped get it there appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 隨著 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 的推出，小米躍居公開可用 AI 模型的頂尖地位，並以極低的價格大幅擊敗競爭對手。這一切得以實現，歸功於耗資 262 萬美元的大規模強化學習。但成功背後也有代價：Anthropic 指控該公司從 Claude 竊取訓練資料。這篇題為「小米平價旗艦 AI 領先開源模型，Anthropic 稱 Claude 助其登上頂峰」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI says its internal model solved over 100 long-standing math problems after just a month of training
items.summary: OpenAI says a new internal model solved more than 100 open math problems after just a month of training. Facing criticism from mathematicians, the company is backing an independent advisory group at the Institute for Advanced Study. But OpenAI has excluded its research pace from the group's advisory role. The article OpenAI says its internal model solved over 100 long-standing math problems after just a month of training appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，其全新的內部模型在經過僅一個月的訓練後，便解決了 100 多個未解的數學難題。面對來自數學家的批評，該公司正在支持位於高等研究院的一個獨立諮詢小組。不過，OpenAI 將其研究進度排除在該小組的諮詢職責之外。OpenAI報導稱其內部模型在僅僅一個月的訓練後就解決了 100 多個長期存在的數學問題，該報導最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: 今年9月底，玉山銀行即將推出第三代GENIE，作為內部統一AI入口，全面導入Agentic AI，要從AI輔助轉為人機協作，進一步邁向代理式銀行（Agentic Banking）願景發展。 GENIE從2024年初以合規防護為目標的OA智能助手1.0版，演進到如今主打規模化的2.0版，每個月Token用量已突破14億個，超過三分之一的員工經常使用，單月模型調用成本卻不到臺幣5萬元。 GENIE是玉山自行研發的OA智能助理，2024年1月正式推出1.0，該年9月升級到2.0，2026年9月即將邁向3.0。(圖片來源：玉山金控)

items.title: Meta patches Muse exploit that let attackers control the AI agent
items.summary: Meta has issued a patch for its Muse macOS app following the discovery of a zero-day vulnerability that could allow someone to take control of the AI agent. The bug found by security researcher Patrick Wardle utilized an undocumented Muse setting that enabled potential attackers running local code to redirect transcription processing from Meta's servers […]
items.summary_zh: 在發現一個可能允許他人控制 AI 代理的零日漏洞後，Meta 已針對其 Muse macOS 應用程式發布修補程式。安全研究員 Patrick Wardle 發現的此錯誤利用了一個未記錄的 Muse 設定，該設定使執行本機程式碼的潛在攻擊者能夠將轉錄處理重新導向至 Meta's 伺服器 […]

items.title: 消息稱高瓴創投合夥人嚴文韜加入DeepSeek，擔任CFO
items.summary: 高瓴創投合夥人嚴文韜9月21日加入DeepSeek任CFO，補齊公司成立三年來空缺的首席財務官職位，顯示治理與財務管理體系進一步完善。嚴文韜1991年生，復旦畢業，曾任職騰訊投資、H Capital及高瓴創投。此前兩個月，多位頭部VC年輕合夥人參與該崗位競聘。

items.title: 騰訊混元圖像3.5來了:畫字更準、修圖更強、一張2K圖只要一毛五
items.summary: 9月22日，騰訊混元發佈圖像3.5預覽版，畫質、排版、修圖等核心能力全面升級，使用成本大幅降低，主打“便宜又好用”。官方稱整體能力較上代提升約30%，文字生成更精準，避免缺筆少畫；排版更能理解畫面佈局需求；修圖能力同步增強。

items.title: 福布斯美國最年輕 10 位億萬富豪：7 人靠 AI 上榜，4 人來自 Anthropic
items.summary: 福布斯美國400富豪榜門檻升至44億美元創新高；40歲以下富豪從4人增至10人，其中7人財富來自AI熱潮且多爲創始人。這7人中有4位來自成立僅五年的AI公司Anthropic，該公司二級市場估值達1.5萬億美元，其7位聯合創始人此前承諾捐出個人財富的80%用於慈善。

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and a new price war
items.summary: Yesterday was Grok 4.7 ( pelicans ) and MiMo v2.6 Flash/Pro ( more pelicans ). Today Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 , and around an hour later OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna . It's going to take a while to get a good read on all of these new models, but here are my impressions so far. GPT-6 Sol and Luna are half the price of their GPT-5.6 equivalents GPT-5.6 Luna was already my favorite model for building applications against, because it combined excellent performance with being really cheap . Somehow GPT-6 Luna is half the price of that again - and GPT-6 Sol had a similar reduction compared to GPT-5.6 Sol. Here's what the pricing landscape looks like today: Model Input Cached input Output GPT-6 Luna $0.10/M $0.01/M $0.50/M GPT-5.6 Luna $0.20/M $0.02/M $1.20/M Grok 4.7 $2/M $0.50/M $6/M GPT-6 Sol $2/M $0.20/M $10/M GPT-5.6 Terra $2/M $0.20/M $12/M Claude Opus 5.5 $4/M $0.20/M $20/M GPT-5.6 Sol $4/M $0.40/M $20/M Claude Fable 5.1 $10/M $0.25/M $50/M GPT-6 Astra $10/M $1/M $50/M Note that GPT-5.6 has a scheduled 25% price increase for November, so GPT-6 is half the price of the promotional pricing for those models. (With GPT-5.6 Terra priced the same as GPT-6 Sol, any remaining reasons to use Terra just evaporated.) It's hard to overstate how competitive this pricing is. Grok 4.7 priced itself at $2/$6, less than half the price of GPT-5.6 Sol, but is now equally priced to GPT-6 Sol on input and closer on output. At $0.10/$0.50 GPT-6 Luna is one of the cheapest models OpenAI have ever released, beaten only by the far weaker GPT-4.1 Nano ($0.10/$0.40, April 2025)
items.summary_zh: 昨天是 Grok 4.7 ( pelicans ) 與 MiMo v2.6 Flash/Pro ( 更多 pelicans )。今天 Anthropic 發布了 Claude Opus 5.5 ，大約一小時後 OpenAI 發布了 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 。要全盤掌握所有這些新模型需要一些時間，但以下是我目前的印象。GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 的價格是其 GPT-5.6 同級產品的一半。GPT-5.6 Luna 已經是我用來建構應用程式的最愛模型，因為它兼具出色的效能與極低的價格。不知何故，GPT-6 Luna 的價格又再度減半——而 GPT-6 Sol 與 GPT-5.6 Sol 相比也有類似的降幅。以下是當前的價格概況：模型 輸入 快取輸入 輸出 GPT-6 Luna $0.10/M $0.01/M $0.50/M GPT-5.6 Luna $0.20/M $0.02/M $1.20/M Grok 4.7 $2/M $0.50/M $6/M GPT-6 Sol $2/M $0.20/M $10/M GPT-5.6 Terra $2/M $0.20/M $12/M Claude Opus 5.5 $4/M $0.20/M $20/M GPT-5.6 Sol $4/M $0.40/M $20/M Claude Fable 5.1 $10/M $0.25/M $50/M GPT-6 Astra $10/M $1/M $50/M 請注意，GPT-5.6 排定在 11 月調漲 25% 的價格，因此 GPT-6 是這些模型促銷價的一半。（隨著 GPT-5.6 Terra 的定價與 GPT-6 Sol 相同，使用 Terra 的任何剩餘理由都煙消雲散了。）這種定價的競爭激烈程度怎麼強調都不為過。Grok 4.7 的定價為 $2/$6，不到 GPT-5.6 Sol 的一半，但現在其輸入價格與 GPT-6 Sol 相同，輸出價格也更接近。在 $0.10/$0.50 的價位下，GPT-6 Luna 是 OpenAI 發布過最便宜的模型之一，僅次於實力弱得多的 GPT-4.1 Nano（$0.10/$0.40，2025 年 4 月）

items.title: llm 0.36
items.summary: Release: llm 0.36 New OpenAI models: gpt-6-sol for GPT-6 Sol and gpt-6-luna for GPT-6 Luna . #1702 Model plugins can now declare supports_conversation = False for models that only accept single-turn prompts. LLM raises llm.ConversationNotSupported when these models receive assistant or tool history, and llm chat rejects them before starting a session. See Models that do not support conversations . The first plugin to use this is llm-typesafe . #1692 Reasoning traces in the Markdown output of llm logs are now wrapped in <details><summary> tags. #1701 Plus bug fixes from five new contributors . Tags: openai , llm
items.summary_zh: 版本發布：llm 0.36 新的 OpenAI 模型：適用於 GPT-6 Sol 的 gpt-6-sol 與適用於 GPT-6 Luna 的 gpt-6-luna。#1702 模型外掛現在可以為僅接受單輪提示詞的模型宣告 supports_conversation = False。當這些模型收到助理或工具歷史記錄時，LLM 會引發 llm.ConversationNotSupported，且 llm 聊天會在啟動工作階段之前拒絕它們。請參閱「不支援對話的模型」。第一個使用此功能的外掛是 llm-typesafe。#1692 llm 記錄的 Markdown 輸出中的推理追蹤現在包覆在 <details><summary> 標籤中。#1701 加上來自五位新貢獻者的錯誤修正。標籤：openai, llm

items.title: llm-typesafe 0.1a0
items.summary: Release: llm-typesafe 0.1a0 I built this new plugin for LLM to add support for TypeSafe AI's new Jev model . Install it like this: llm install llm-typesafe Then set an API key ( get one here , the waitlist seems to move pretty fast): llm keys set typesafe # Paste key And now you can ask yes/no "noul" questions like this: llm -m jev 'Please refund my last payment.' \ -s 'Does this message explicitly request a refund?' Output: {"type": "noul", "noul": 0.99} Or choice questions like this: cat message.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' Which team should handle this message? If billing and technical issues both occur, choose billing. ' \ -o answer_type choice \ -o criteria ' { "billing":"Charges, invoices, payments, or refunds", "technical":"Problems installing or using the product", "other":"Neither category fits" } ' Or scoring questions like this: cat report.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' How reproducible is the problem described in this report? ' \ -o answer_type score \ -o criteria ' [ "No reproduction instructions", "Some instructions, but important steps are missing", "Complete steps with expected and actual results" ] ' See the README for more details. Tags: projects , llm , jev
items.summary_zh: 版本釋出：llm-typesafe 0.1a0 我為 LLM 建立了這個新外掛程式，以增加對 TypeSafe AI 的新 Jev 模型的支援。安裝方式如下：llm install llm-typesafe 接著設定 API 金鑰（在此處取得，候診名單似乎推進得蠻快的）：llm keys set typesafe # 貼上金鑰 接著你就可以詢問是/否「noul」類型問題，例如：llm -m jev 'Please refund my last payment.' \ -s 'Does this message explicitly request a refund?' 輸出：{"type": "noul", "noul": 0.99} 或者選擇題類型問題，例如：cat message.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' Which team should handle this message? If billing and technical issues both occur, choose billing. ' \ -o answer_type choice \ -o criteria ' { "billing":"Charges, invoices, payments, or refunds", "technical":"Problems installing or using the product", "other":"Neither category fits" } ' 或者評分題類型問題，例如：cat report.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' How reproducible is the problem described in this report? ' \ -o answer_type score \ -o criteria ' [ "No reproduction instructions", "Some instructions, but important steps are missing", "Complete steps with expected and actual results" ] ' 更多詳細資訊請參閱 README。標籤：專案、llm、jev

items_ai.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance
items_ai.summary: With GPT-6 Sol and Luna, OpenAI adds two cheaper models that deliver their predecessors' performance at half the token price and take aim at Anthropic's pricier offerings. Independent analyses find little gain in actual intelligence, though, and OpenAI likely didn't see Anthropic's simultaneous launch of Opus 5.5 coming. The article OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 透過 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna，OpenAI 推出了兩款更便宜的模型，以半價的 Token 價格提供其前代模型的效能，並將矛頭指向 Anthropic's 較昂貴的產品。不過，獨立分析發現實際智慧程度幾無提升，而且 OpenAI 可能沒料到 Anthropic's 會同時推出 Opus 5.5。這篇名為 OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance 的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Claude Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1 performance at lower cost and promises less "Claudish" writing
items_ai.summary: Anthropic is launching Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in a new generation. The company says it matches Claude Fable 5.1 on most tasks while costing about 40 percent less to run than Opus 5. Anthropic's benchmarks also put it ahead of OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on most tasks, despite being significantly cheaper. Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are expected in the coming weeks. The article Claude Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1 performance at lower cost and promises less "Claudish" writing appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出新一代的首款模型 Claude Opus 5.5。該公司表示，它在多數任務上與 Claude Fable 5.1 相當，而運行成本比 Opus 5 低約 40%。儘管價格顯著便宜，但 Anthropic's 基準測試也顯示它在多數任務上領先 OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra。Sonnet 5.5 和 Haiku 5.5 預計將在未來幾週內推出。這篇題為 Claude Opus 5.5 的文章發表在 The Decoder 上，內容為以更低的成本達到 Fable 5.1 的效能，並承諾減少「更像 Claude」的寫作風格。

items_ai.title: OpenAI calls for international standards on AI that could improve itself
items_ai.summary: OpenAI wants international standards for recursive self-improvement, where AI systems independently build the next generation of AI. Without safeguards, humans could lose control over this process. OpenAI says the US should take the lead on global measurement standards and oversight rules. The article OpenAI calls for international standards on AI that could improve itself appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 呼籲為遞迴自我改進（即 AI 系統獨立建立下一代 AI）制定國際標準。如果沒有安全防護措施，人類可能會失去對此過程的控制。OpenAI 表示，美國應該在全球衡量標準和監督規則方面居於領先地位。這篇名為 OpenAI 的文章首次發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: A tiny software layer from lab-grown neurons promises faster, cheaper AI video
items_ai.summary: The Biological Computing Co. wants to team up with AWS to sell a text-to-video model that's supposed to run five times faster and 80 percent cheaper thanks to a software layer derived from real nerve cells. The tiny layer adds less than 0.1 percent to the base model, but the startup won't say which model that is. The article A tiny software layer from lab-grown neurons promises faster, cheaper AI video appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and a new price war
items_ai.summary: Yesterday was Grok 4.7 ( pelicans ) and MiMo v2.6 Flash/Pro ( more pelicans ). Today Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 , and around an hour later OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna . It's going to take a while to get a good read on all of these new models, but here are my impressions so far. GPT-6 Sol and Luna are half the price of their GPT-5.6 equivalents GPT-5.6 Luna was already my favorite model for building applications against, because it combined excellent performance with being really cheap . Somehow GPT-6 Luna is half the price of that again - and GPT-6 Sol had a similar reduction compared to GPT-5.6 Sol. Here's what the pricing landscape looks like today: Model Input Cached input Output GPT-6 Luna $0.10/M $0.01/M $0.50/M GPT-5.6 Luna $0.20/M $0.02/M $1.20/M Grok 4.7 $2/M $0.50/M $6/M GPT-6 Sol $2/M $0.20/M $10/M GPT-5.6 Terra $2/M $0.20/M $12/M Claude Opus 5.5 $4/M $0.20/M $20/M GPT-5.6 Sol $4/M $0.40/M $20/M Claude Fable 5.1 $10/M $0.25/M $50/M GPT-6 Astra $10/M $1/M $50/M Note that GPT-5.6 has a scheduled 25% price increase for November, so GPT-6 is half the price of the promotional pricing for those models. (With GPT-5.6 Terra priced the same as GPT-6 Sol, any remaining reasons to use Terra just evaporated.) It's hard to overstate how competitive this pricing is. Grok 4.7 priced itself at $2/$6, less than half the price of GPT-5.6 Sol, but is now equally priced to GPT-6 Sol on input and closer on output. At $0.10/$0.50 GPT-6 Luna is one of the cheapest models OpenAI have ever released, beaten only by the far weaker GPT-4.1 Nano ($0.10/$0.40, April 2025)
items_ai.summary_zh: 昨天是 Grok 4.7 ( pelicans ) 與 MiMo v2.6 Flash/Pro ( 更多 pelicans )。今天 Anthropic 發布了 Claude Opus 5.5 ，大約一小時後 OpenAI 發布了 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 。要全盤掌握所有這些新模型需要一些時間，但以下是我目前的印象。GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 的價格是其 GPT-5.6 同級產品的一半。GPT-5.6 Luna 已經是我用來建構應用程式的最愛模型，因為它兼具出色的效能與極低的價格。不知何故，GPT-6 Luna 的價格又再度減半——而 GPT-6 Sol 與 GPT-5.6 Sol 相比也有類似的降幅。以下是當前的價格概況：模型 輸入 快取輸入 輸出 GPT-6 Luna $0.10/M $0.01/M $0.50/M GPT-5.6 Luna $0.20/M $0.02/M $1.20/M Grok 4.7 $2/M $0.50/M $6/M GPT-6 Sol $2/M $0.20/M $10/M GPT-5.6 Terra $2/M $0.20/M $12/M Claude Opus 5.5 $4/M $0.20/M $20/M GPT-5.6 Sol $4/M $0.40/M $20/M Claude Fable 5.1 $10/M $0.25/M $50/M GPT-6 Astra $10/M $1/M $50/M 請注意，GPT-5.6 排定在 11 月調漲 25% 的價格，因此 GPT-6 是這些模型促銷價的一半。（隨著 GPT-5.6 Terra 的定價與 GPT-6 Sol 相同，使用 Terra 的任何剩餘理由都煙消雲散了。）這種定價的競爭激烈程度怎麼強調都不為過。Grok 4.7 的定價為 $2/$6，不到 GPT-5.6 Sol 的一半，但現在其輸入價格與 GPT-6 Sol 相同，輸出價格也更接近。在 $0.10/$0.50 的價位下，GPT-6 Luna 是 OpenAI 發布過最便宜的模型之一，僅次於實力弱得多的 GPT-4.1 Nano（$0.10/$0.40，2025 年 4 月）

items_ai.title: llm 0.36
items_ai.summary: Release: llm 0.36 New OpenAI models: gpt-6-sol for GPT-6 Sol and gpt-6-luna for GPT-6 Luna . #1702 Model plugins can now declare supports_conversation = False for models that only accept single-turn prompts. LLM raises llm.ConversationNotSupported when these models receive assistant or tool history, and llm chat rejects them before starting a session. See Models that do not support conversations . The first plugin to use this is llm-typesafe . #1692 Reasoning traces in the Markdown output of llm logs are now wrapped in <details><summary> tags. #1701 Plus bug fixes from five new contributors . Tags: openai , llm
items_ai.summary_zh: 版本發布：llm 0.36 新的 OpenAI 模型：適用於 GPT-6 Sol 的 gpt-6-sol 與適用於 GPT-6 Luna 的 gpt-6-luna。#1702 模型外掛現在可以為僅接受單輪提示詞的模型宣告 supports_conversation = False。當這些模型收到助理或工具歷史記錄時，LLM 會引發 llm.ConversationNotSupported，且 llm 聊天會在啟動工作階段之前拒絕它們。請參閱「不支援對話的模型」。第一個使用此功能的外掛是 llm-typesafe。#1692 llm 記錄的 Markdown 輸出中的推理追蹤現在包覆在 <details><summary> 標籤中。#1701 加上來自五位新貢獻者的錯誤修正。標籤：openai, llm

items_ai.title: llm-typesafe 0.1a0
items_ai.summary: Release: llm-typesafe 0.1a0 I built this new plugin for LLM to add support for TypeSafe AI's new Jev model . Install it like this: llm install llm-typesafe Then set an API key ( get one here , the waitlist seems to move pretty fast): llm keys set typesafe # Paste key And now you can ask yes/no "noul" questions like this: llm -m jev 'Please refund my last payment.' \ -s 'Does this message explicitly request a refund?' Output: {"type": "noul", "noul": 0.99} Or choice questions like this: cat message.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' Which team should handle this message? If billing and technical issues both occur, choose billing. ' \ -o answer_type choice \ -o criteria ' { "billing":"Charges, invoices, payments, or refunds", "technical":"Problems installing or using the product", "other":"Neither category fits" } ' Or scoring questions like this: cat report.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' How reproducible is the problem described in this report? ' \ -o answer_type score \ -o criteria ' [ "No reproduction instructions", "Some instructions, but important steps are missing", "Complete steps with expected and actual results" ] ' See the README for more details. Tags: projects , llm , jev
items_ai.summary_zh: 版本釋出：llm-typesafe 0.1a0 我為 LLM 建立了這個新外掛程式，以增加對 TypeSafe AI 的新 Jev 模型的支援。安裝方式如下：llm install llm-typesafe 接著設定 API 金鑰（在此處取得，候診名單似乎推進得蠻快的）：llm keys set typesafe # 貼上金鑰 接著你就可以詢問是/否「noul」類型問題，例如：llm -m jev 'Please refund my last payment.' \ -s 'Does this message explicitly request a refund?' 輸出：{"type": "noul", "noul": 0.99} 或者選擇題類型問題，例如：cat message.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' Which team should handle this message? If billing and technical issues both occur, choose billing. ' \ -o answer_type choice \ -o criteria ' { "billing":"Charges, invoices, payments, or refunds", "technical":"Problems installing or using the product", "other":"Neither category fits" } ' 或者評分題類型問題，例如：cat report.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' How reproducible is the problem described in this report? ' \ -o answer_type score \ -o criteria ' [ "No reproduction instructions", "Some instructions, but important steps are missing", "Complete steps with expected and actual results" ] ' 更多詳細資訊請參閱 README。標籤：專案、llm、jev
